1.1.0: add MakeApiCall component with key-value array inputs for headers and parameters per standard #1459
Added output examples to component schemas.
1.1.1: Added an Ed25519 `X-GHL-Signature` webhook verification helper to lib.js, ahead of HighLevel deprecating the legacy RSA-SHA256 `X-WH-Signature` header on September 1, 2026.
MakeApiCall: parse the JSON-string form of the headers/parameters key-value inputs (the designer serializes them as strings), so custom headers like Version are actually sent.
1.1.2: Added output schemas with examples to CreateContact, GetContact, UpdateContact, UpdateOpportunity, ListCalendars and ListPipelines.
1.1.3: CreateAppointment and CreateOpportunity now stop with a clear error when a required input is missing instead of calling the API; the calendar and pipeline pickers are typeaheads; added output schemas with examples.
